segments.text: Okay, so... I don't know how to say this without sounding dramatic, but... I'm kind of terrified.
Not like horror movie terrified. Just... what if this whole YouTube thing doesn't work?
Like, I love making these animations. I spend days obsessing over every little frame...
...and then I refresh at two AM, and it's seven views. Half of them from my phone.
And my brain immediately goes: what if nobody watches, and I just never get better?
I see all these insane animators online, and then I look at my timeline and it's just pure chaos.
And the only reason it's scary is because I actually care. Like, a lot.
Look, I'm probably just overthinking again. But I'm still gonna make the next video.
So yeah, wish me luck. Okay, bye!
